edges.condition_text: EXEC CICS RECEIVE MAP(LIT-THISMAP) MAPSET(LIT-THISMAPSET) INTO(CTRTLIAI) RESP(WS-RESP-CD) END-EXEC MOVE TRTYPEI  OF CTRTLIAI  TO WS-IN-TYPE-CD MOVE TRDESCI  OF CTRTLIAI  TO WS-IN-TYPE-DESC PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES MOVE TRTSELI(I)           TO WS-EDIT-SELECT(I) MOVE TRTTYPI(I)           TO WS-ROW-TR-CODE-IN(I) MOVE LOW-VALUES           TO WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I) IF   TRTYPDI(I) = LIT-ASTERISK OR   TRTYPDI(I) = SPACES CONTINUE ELSE MOVE FUNCTION TRIM(TRTYPDI(I)) TO WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I) END-IF END-PERFORM .

PERFORM VARYING I FROM WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES BY -1 UNTIL I = 0 MOVE DFHBMPRF                 TO TRTYPDA(I) IF   WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT(I)    EQUAL LOW-VALUES OR   FLG-PROTECT-SELECT-ROWS-YES MOVE DFHBMPRO              TO TRTSELA (I) ELSE IF WS-ROW-TRTSELECT-ERROR(I) = '1' MOVE DFHRED             TO TRTSELC(I) MOVE -1                 TO TRTSELL(I) END-IF IF DELETE-REQUESTED-ON(I) AND WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION AND FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO MOVE DFHNEUTR           TO TRTTYPC(I) TRTYPDC(I) MOVE -1                 TO TRTSELL(I) END-IF IF UPDATE-REQUESTED-ON(I) AND WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION AND FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO MOVE DFHNEUTR           TO TRTTYPC(I) IF  FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED MOVE -1             TO TRTSELL(I) MOVE DFHNEUTR       TO TRTYPDC(I) ELSE MOVE -1             TO TRTYPDL(I) MOVE DFHBMFSE       TO TRTYPDA(I) IF NOT FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-ISVALID MOVE DFHRED      TO TRTYPDC(I) END-IF END-IF END-IF MOVE DFHBMFSE              TO TRTSELA(I) END-IF END-PERFORM .

PERFORM VARYING I FROM 1 BY 1 UNTIL I > WS-MAX-SCREEN-LINES IF   WS-CA-EACH-ROW-OUT(I)         EQUAL LOW-VALUES CONTINUE ELSE IF  DELETE-REQUESTED-ON(I) AND WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION AND FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO IF  FLG-DELETED-YES SET SELECT-BLANK(I)          TO TRUE ELSE SET CA-DELETE-REQUESTED      TO TRUE END-IF END-IF MOVE WS-CA-ROW-TR-CODE-OUT(I)        TO TRTTYPO(I) IF UPDATE-REQUESTED-ON(I) AND WS-ONLY-1-VALID-ACTION AND FLG-BAD-ACTIONS-SELECTED-NO IF  FLG-UPDATE-COMPLETED SET SELECT-BLANK(I)          TO TRUE ELSE SET CA-UPDATE-REQUESTED      TO TRUE END-IF IF CHANGES-HAVE-OCCURRED EVALUATE TRUE WHEN FLG-ROW-DESCRIPTION-BLANK MOVE LIT-ASTERISK    TO TRTYPDO(I) WHEN OTHER MOVE WS-ROW-TR-DESC-IN(I) TO TRTYPDO(I) END-EVALUATE ELSE MOVE WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(I) TO TRTYPDO(I) END-IF ELSE MOVE WS-CA-ROW-TR-DESC-OUT(I)    TO TRTYPDO(I) END-IF MOVE WS-EDIT-SELECT(I)               TO TRTSELO(I) END-IF END-PERFORM .
